text: SELECT ass.chembl_id AS assay_chembl_id, td.target_type, td.tax_id, cs.canonical_smiles AS canonical_smiles, mol.chembl_id AS molecule_chembl_id, a.standard_type, a.pchembl_value AS pchembl_value FROM activities a INNER JOIN assays ass ON a.assay_id = ass.assay_id INNER JOIN target_dictionary td ON ass.tid = td.tid INNER JOIN molecule_dictionary mol ON a.molregno = mol.molregno INNER JOIN compound_structures cs ON mol.molregno = cs.molregno WHERE a.standard_relation = '=' AND a.pchembl_value IS NOT NULL AND td.chembl_id = 'CHEMBL1628465' AND td.tax_id = 9606 AND td.target_type = 'SINGLE PROTEIN' ORDER BY mol.chembl_id ASC, ass.chembl_id ASC LIMIT 1000
